title: feat: add Nex N2.5 Pro via OpenRouter
author: tomdacatto

gist.summary: Added paid-only Nex N2.5 Pro (`nex-agi/nex-n2.5-pro`) with no aliases, a 1× multiplier, a 262,144-token context, image input, tool calling, reasoning, and structured output. Input, cached input, and output are billed in Pollen per million tokens; the rates include OpenRouter’s 5.5% fee once. Requests are pinned to OpenRouter’s `nex-agi/fp8` route, with provider fallback disabled. Added the Nex AGI logo and model information. Chat, Responses, and Messages use guarded image conversion: valid remote images are sent inline, while invalid remote image URLs return HTTP 400.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears tiny programmer glasses and guides picture cards into a retro terminal displaying a small Nex N2.5 Pro model tile, while code-plants grow beside it; the main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, small-to-medium in the scene and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, chunky retro sprites, soft pastel gradients over a warm cream background, prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow, dark purple (#110518) outlines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
